text: dsh-ticktick 是面向 DSH Web 的 TickTick / Dida365 任务管理与同步插件。它在 DSH 注册 agent 工具、Web 设置面板和本机 OAuth 回调，可读取清单与待办任务、创建和更新任务、完成或删除任务，并支持拉取汇总及按清单标题去重的推送同步。适合希望在 DSH 对话中管理滴答清单待办的用户；使用前需准备开放平台 client_id、client_secret 并完成账号授权。

dsh-ticktick connects DSH Web to TickTick / Dida365. Its tools and settings panel support OAuth authorization, task and list access, task creation, updates, completion and deletion, plus pull or deduplicated push sync. It helps manage to-dos in DSH; an open-platform client ID and secret are needed.
想在 DSH 对话里查看 TickTick 各清单的待办任务
帮我把 DSH 里的任务同步到滴答清单，已有的别重复创建
I want to create and update TickTick tasks from my DSH assistant.
dsh-ticktick 的功能「跨清单拉取任务」：通过 agent 工具按清单读取未完成或已完成任务，并按截止时间整理结果。
dsh-ticktick 的功能「双向任务同步」：调用 ticktick_sync 拉取分组摘要，或将任务推送到对应清单，并按清单内标题跳过已存在任务。
dsh-ticktick 使用前须知：需用开放平台 client_id 和 client_secret 完成 OAuth；任务读写会发送到所选区域的官方 API，凭据与令牌保存在本机配置文件。
dsh-ticktick 的维护与更新元数据：已归档；距最后推送 43 天；提交数 13；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 22/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-ticktick README · dsh-ticktick：> **English** | [**中文**](README.zh.md)

Two-way task sync with [TickTick](https://ticktick.com) / [Dida365](https://dida365.com) (滴答清单) for DeepSeek Harness, built on the official OAuth 2.0 Open API. Pull tasks across every list, create / update / complete / delete tasks, and run a one-shot dedupe sync — from the agent or the web settings panel.

dsh-ticktick README · Features：- **Official Open API** — OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow against the TickTick / Dida365 open platform (`/open/v1`), with automatic token refresh on 401.
- **Both regions** — Dida365 (CN, default) and TickTick (international), selectable in the settings panel or via `ticktick_config`.
- **Pull** — `ticktick_tasks` / `ticktick_sync` list incomplete (or completed) tasks across all lists (the **收集箱 Inbox included**, even though the Open API's project list omits it), sorted by due date, with list names.
- **Push** — `ticktick_add` creates one or more tasks (title, list by id or name — `inbox` / `收集箱` resolve to the Inbox, due date in ISO 8601 or bare `YYYY-MM-DD`, priority 0-5 or none/low/medium/high, tags, content).
- **One-shot sync** — `ticktick_sync` with `direction=pull` (grouped summary) or `direction=push` (creates missing tasks, dedupes by title within a list, Inbox included — re-running never duplicates).
- **Maintenance** — `ticktick_update`, `ticktick_complete`, `ticktick_delete` (project id optional; auto-resolved, Inbox included).
- **Settings panel** — Settings → TickTick: configure credentials, run the authorize flow (popup + manual code

Restart `dsh web`. The plugin needs no build step — `lib/index.js` is plain ESM.

dsh-ticktick README · Configuration：1. Create an app in the open platform console: <https://developer.dida365.com/docs#/openapi> (CN) or <https://developer.ticktick.com/manage/> (international), and register the redirect URI:

```
   http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-ticktick/oauth/callback
   ```

(use your actual `dsh web` port, or set a custom `redirectUri` — it must match exactly.)

2. Give the plugin your `client_id` / `client_secret`, either in the settings panel (Settings → TickTick) or by asking the agent:

dsh-ticktick README · Configuration：```text
   帮我配置滴答清单，client_id 是 xxx，client_secret 是 yyy，区域用国内版 Dida365
   ```

The agent calls `ticktick_config` and persists the credentials.

3. Authorize: click **开始授权** in the panel (or `ticktick_oauth_start`) and log in. The callback completes automatically; if it doesn't, paste the code back and call `ticktick_oauth_finish`.

From then on:

dsh-ticktick README · Configuration：```text
把今天滴答清单里没做完的任务同步给我          → ticktick_sync (pull)
帮我把这些任务同步到滴答清单：买牛奶、写周报   → ticktick_sync (push, dedupes)
明天下午3点提醒我开会，加到「工作」清单       → ticktick_add
```

> The `client_secret` and OAuth tokens are credentials: anyone holding them can read and change your tasks. They stay in `~/.dsh/dsh-ticktick.json` (mode `0600`); use `ticktick_config(reset: true)` to clear them if they leak.

dsh-ticktick README · API surface：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `ticktick_status` | connection & authorization status |
| `ticktick_config` | set / clear `clientId`, `clientSecret`, `region` (`cn`/`intl`), `redirectUri` |
| `ticktick_oauth_start` | build the authorize URL |
| `ticktick_oauth_finish` | exchange a pasted `code` / redirect URL for tokens |
| `ticktick_lists` | list all lists (id + name) |
| `ticktick_tasks` | pull tasks (by list, completed flag, limit) |
| `ticktick_add` | create tasks |
| `ticktick_update` | update a task |
| `ticktick_complete` | complete a task |
| `ticktick_delete` | delete a task |
| `ticktick_sync` | pull summary / push with title dedupe |

dsh-ticktick README · Notes：- Uses Node's built-in `fetch` (Node 22+) and `crypto` — zero runtime dependencies.
- The OAuth callback route is loopback-only and verifies the OAuth `state`; the remaining `/api/dsh-ticktick/*` routes are loopback + same-origin only.
- Not covered by the open API: smart-list filters and time-triggered reminders (`reminders`/`repeatFlag` are passed through when present, but not modeled as tool parameters).
- The web settings panel talks to the host through the loopback-only `/api/dsh-ticktick` route family.
